Projects

Major project · Unsupervised ML

Customer Segmentation Using K-Means Clustering

Grouping mall customers by income and spending behaviour to sharpen marketing strategy.

Python · Pandas · Scikit-learn · Matplotlib · Jupyter

Problem. Businesses need to group customers by behaviour to target marketing more effectively. This project clusters the "Mall Customers" dataset (Customer ID, Gender, Age, Annual Income, Spending Score) using Annual Income and Spending Score as features.

Method. After checking for missing values and preparing the feature set, the Elbow Method was used to find the right number of clusters (k), then K-Means was fit and the resulting groups were visualised and profiled.

  1. Load & clean dataset
  2. Select income + spending features
  3. Run Elbow Method → k = 5
  4. Fit K-Means, assign clusters
  5. Visualise & profile each segment
Elbow method — choosing k
Five customer segments (k-means)
High income · High spendMost valuable segment — premium products, exclusive offers, loyalty focus.
High income · Low spendPurchasing power, low engagement — worth targeted discounts and campaigns.
Low income · High spendTrend-driven shoppers — respond well to offers and seasonal sales.
Low income · Low spendBudget segment — best served with basic, affordable offers.
Medium · MediumStable, steady customers — good candidates for reward programs.
Minor project · Exploratory Data Analysis

Exploratory Data Analysis on a Sales Dataset

Reading revenue, region and discount patterns out of raw retail sales records.

Python · Pandas · NumPy · Matplotlib/Seaborn · Jupyter

Problem. Analyse a retail sales dataset to identify patterns, trends and business insights across products, regions and time.

Method. The dataset was cleaned, checked for errors, and enriched with a derived Month column, then explored through a series of trend, comparison and correlation charts.

  1. Load & clean dataset
  2. Derive Month from Order Date
  3. Chart trends by month, product, region
  4. Correlate discount against profit
  5. Summarise business insights
Sales by category
Sales by region
01Furniture led on total sales, but Technology — despite lower revenue — generated the strongest profit, while Furniture's margin was close to break-even.
02The West region drove the largest share of revenue (61.3%), well ahead of South and Central.
03Heavier discounts consistently pulled profit down — a clear inverse relationship in the data.
04Monthly sales swung sharply rather than trending smoothly, pointing to distinct seasonal peaks.
